Cosmo.name: Cosmo VanDalay
Cosmo.appearance: Dashing halfling, with a goatee and unkempt hair. Wearing chainmail ornamented with images of vines and nature.
Cosmo.personality: Through your acts of mercy, kindness, and forgiveness, kindle the light of hope in the world, beating back despair.
Cosmo.backstory: Citizen of the halfling village Hamptons, while raising a family was encouraged to adventure as a company with his family.
Cosmo.notes: Respect the life and the love and the beauty. Art and life are everywhere. Bring hope to the world

Mulva.name: Mulva VanDalay
Mulva.appearance: Long curly unkempt hair and leather armor. Carries a violin with her.
Mulva.personality: Knowledgable, know it all, answer for everything
Mulva.backstory: Citizen of the halfling village Hamptons, while raising a family was encouraged to adventure as a company with his family.
Mulva.notes: Caretaker and supporter of her family and those around her..

Art.name: Art VanDalay
Art.appearance: Small younger halfling male, the image of his father.
Art.backstory: Citizen of the halfling village Hamptons, while raising a family was encouraged to adventure as a company with his family.
Art.notes: Enjoys revalry and playful attitudes. Jokes and pranks.

Mia.name: Mia VanDalay
Mia.appearance: Small even for halfling sizes. Barely out of childhood embracing the arcane.
Mia.personality: Young naive and unsure of herself.
Mia.backstory: Citizen of the halfling village Hamptons, while raising a family was encouraged to adventure as a company with his family.
Mia.notes: Unsure of her actions and what to do at any given time, frustration lends to flight.

Bix.name: Bix (Roxy) VanDalay
Bix.appearance: Small tabaxi rogue in leathers, grey fur and bit green eyes.
Bix.personality: Wildcard personality, uncertainty is her middle name.
Bix.backstory: Citizen of the halfling village Hamptons, while raising a family was encouraged to adventure as a company with his family.
Bix.notes: Quick to anger and easy to provoke.

Pickles.name: Pickles VanDalay
Pickles.personality: Young naive and prone to outbursts has no understanding of her own power.
Pickles.backstory: VanDalay family found her alone in the wood and provided her a place and helped her grow, now part of the family.
